**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§ 8.2** — automatic renewal in successive **12-month** terms (no multi-year renewal, so no walk-away risk), Customer non-renewal notice of only **30 days**, plus a **60-day Vendor reminder** with an opt-out extension if the reminder is missed.
- **§ 8.3** — renewal uplift capped at the **lesser of trailing 12-month CPI-U and 3%**, with no increase on prepaid periods.
- **§ 7.1** — Fees fixed during the initial term; no hidden surcharges. No other renewal or escalator language exists in the document.

All preferred elements are met, so no redline was proposed.
